desktop.notesZh: 0.0.16：弹窗可靠性四连修——①跨 isolate 服务解析（agentPresets.serviceFor 唯一读通道；弹窗点「初始化工作区」后派发真能拿到服务；提示语去术语；卡片首行统一「点本行展开/折叠详情」）；②分类弹窗明选 + baf_gate_ask requirement 引导（系统初步判断/需求摘要进弹窗；客户陈述需求一调铸变更+弹分类卡；未初始化自动改弹初始化卡；题卡说明行渲染内缩修复）；③两路径改道可点 + 缺陷草案进弹窗（确认 · 完整流程 / 确认 · 缺陷修复路径直接点选，改判落 intake-mode-set 事件审计；problem/root-cause/files/test/testCmd 草案带进弹窗，一次点击定路径+交字段）；④宿主面自动弹 + 通用提问硬拦（空闲工作区直接说需求 → 预问卡 → 分类卡，平台保证不再依赖模型；有未决门时 ask_user_question 被 guard 拦下 gate_pending_ask_blocked 指路 baf_gate_ask）；另修 Windows 并发读竞态（projection 原子写 rename EPERM 短重试，客户确认点击不再被 Tab 刷新误杀）
desktop.notesEn: 0.0.16: Popup-reliability quadruple fix — (1) cross-isolate service resolution (agentPresets.serviceFor as the only read channel; the scaffold-dialog click dispatch now actually reaches its services; de-jargoned hints; unified card first line '· 点本行展开/折叠详情'); (2) informed classify dialog + baf_gate_ask requirement bootstrap (system judgment & summary rendered in the dialog; one call mints the change and pops classify; uninitialized workspaces redirect to the scaffold gate; composer detail-line inset fix); (3) clickable path re-routing + bug draft in the dialog (确认 · 完整流程 / 确认 · 缺陷修复路径 as direct buttons with the override audited as an intake-mode-set event; problem/rootCause/files/test/testCmd draft rides the dialog — one click settles path + fields); (4) host-plane auto-pop + generic-question hard block (stating a requirement in an idle workspace pops the pre-question then the classify card as a platform guarantee; ask_user_question is guard-blocked with gate_pending_ask_blocked while a gate is pending, pointing at baf_gate_ask); plus a Windows concurrent-reader race fix (projection atomic-write rename EPERM short retry — a customer's confirm click can no longer be killed by a Tab refresh)
